lines: Ab to itni bhi nahin milti hai maikhane mein
couplets.en: These days the tavern pours so little.

lines: Ab to itni bhi nahin milti hai maikhane mein
Jitni hum chhod diya karte the paimane mein
couplets.en: The tavern now pours less than I used to leave in my cup.

lines: Main nazar se pee raha hoon, yeh samaa badal na jaaye
couplets.en: I drink with my eyes, may this moment hold.

lines: Main nazar se pee raha hoon, yeh samaa badal na jaaye
couplets.en: I drink with my eyes, may this moment hold.

lines: Main nazar se pee raha hoon, yeh samaa badal na jaaye
Na jhukao tum nigaahein, kahin raat dhal na jaaye
couplets.en: I drink with my eyes, so keep your gaze upon me lest the night slip away and take this moment with it.

lines: Na jhukao tum nigaahein, kahin raat dhal na jaaye
couplets.en: Keep your gaze upon me lest the night slip away.

lines: Mere ashk bhi hain is mein, yeh sharaab ubal na jaaye
couplets.en: My tears are in this wine too, and I fear it may come to a boil.

lines: Mere ashk bhi hain is mein, yeh sharaab ubal na jaaye
Mera jaam chhoone waale, tera haath jal na jaaye
couplets.en: My tears are in this wine too, and if it comes to a boil my cup may burn your hand.

lines: Mera jaam chhoone waale, tera haath jal na jaaye
couplets.en: Take care as you touch my cup, for it may burn your hand.

lines: Meri zindagi ke maalik, mere dil pe haath rakh de
couplets.en: You who hold my life, lay your hand upon my heart.

lines: Meri zindagi ke maalik, mere dil pe haath rakh de
Tere aane ki khushi mein, mera dam nikal na jaaye
couplets.en: You who hold my life, lay your hand upon my heart lest the joy of your coming take my last breath.

lines: Tere aane ki khushi mein, mera dam nikal na jaaye
Main nazar se pee raha hoon, yeh samaa badal na jaaye
couplets.en: The joy of your coming may take my last breath, yet I drink with my eyes and wish this moment would hold.
